shortDescription: Query information on one or more servers

options.name: full_info
options.description: Whether to provide full information for every server. Setting this to V(true) requires one REST call per server, which is slow and reduces your rate limit. Use with care. When O(server_number) is specified, this option is always treated as having value V(true).

options.name: hetzner_password
options.description: The password for the Robot web-service user.

options.name: hetzner_user
options.description: The username for the Robot web-service user.

options.name: rate_limit_retry_timeout
options.description: Timeout (in seconds) for waiting when rate limit exceeded errors are returned. Set to V(0) to not retry. Set to a negative value like V(-1) to retry forever.

options.name: server_name
options.description: Limit result list to servers of this name.

options.name: server_number
options.description: Limit result list to server with this number.
